# Chandrika Singh

> Marketing strategist based in Singapore. MSc Marketing Science candidate at Nanyang Business School, NTU, and Marketing & BD Associate at betheanswer.to, helping brands get named accurately by AI assistants (AEO/GEO). Specialises in brand positioning, consumer research, AI search visibility and integrated marketing campaigns.

## Work with Chandrika

- AI visibility audit (delivered through betheanswer.to, pricing on request): buyer prompts tested across AI assistants, where rivals win and why, and a 90-day plan.
- Market research report (from S$2,500): surveys, interviews, mystery shops and social listening; segments, positioning and market size.
- Go-to-market plan (from S$3,500): target, message, campaign, media, creators and CRM, with budget, break-even and a pilot.
- Strategy session (S$150, 60 minutes): one marketing question, with written notes after.
- Free 20-minute intro call. Enquire via the form on the site or chandrikasingh4395@gmail.com

## Experience (5+ years)

- betheanswer.to, Singapore: Marketing & BD Associate (2026 to now). AI search visibility (AEO/GEO) for brands.
- All Things Fun: Freelance Marketing Consultant and Community Builder (Sep 2025 to Feb 2026).
- Mai Labs: Brand & Marketing Manager, then Consultant (Nov 2022 to Mar 2025). Led a team of 10+ marketers; helped win an INR 2M public-sector deal.
- Zee Media Corporation: Assistant Brand Manager (Apr 2021 to Nov 2022). Lifted website and app click-through rate 50% in two months.

## What makes Chandrika different

A behavioural background: economics, psychology and sociology (BA), then public policy (MA), before marketing. The work focuses on how customers actually decide, which nudges change behaviour, and what the evidence can and cannot prove.

Languages: English, Hindi.

## Skills, with proof

- Strategy and positioning: Chief Marketing Strategy Officer of MegaCorp in a Markstrat simulation; the team finished first of six firms with $346M revenue, $191M profit before tax (55% margin) and a share price index 44% above the runner-up.
- Consumer research: Reddit research (52 respondents), expert interviews, mystery shops, social listening and an AI answer audit (60 answers) for Grand Seiko in Singapore.
- AI search visibility (AEO/GEO): audited 32 buyer prompts in three languages for a Southeast Asian mobile network (recommended in 3 of 24 unbranded prompts) and wrote a 90-day plan to reach 9; researched AI presence for a hospital group in India.
- Campaigns and IMC: an 8-week, S$40,000 Singapore campaign for Hey! Chips, sized from TAM (0.95M) to SOM (5,000-8,000 buyers), with #HeyFitCheck and a Crunch Check sampling game.
- Digital marketing: built the Euthymol deck, a S$138K Singapore plan (#TheLastDetail Valentine's campaign, craftspeople creators, Euthymol Life website and Polished Club CRM, hotel amenity pilot) forecast to add S$234K sales in Year 1 and pay back by month 18.
- Competitive strategy: blue ocean strategy for The Riverhouse, a heritage venue in Clarke Quay (course project with a live brief).

## Methods

Segmentation, perceptual mapping, semantic scales, conjoint analysis, TAM/SAM/SOM sizing, blue ocean strategy canvas, mystery shopping, social listening, buyer-prompt testing for AI assistants, schema and llms.txt audits, media planning, break-even pilot design.
